notes: 60000 = 40000 stage 1 (2DGS + k-sort k=16 + frustum) + Fisher prune 10% + 20000 texture stage (official run_360.py both branches). Indoor uses hdgs-indoor (tex_res 500, official code; paper text 400). Expect ~3-6 h per scene (k-buffer rasterizer ~5-10x slower per step than gsplat) and texture buffer+Adam memory up to ~10-15 GB on counter at step 40000 -> place on a GPU with >=30 GB free. First job JIT-compiles two extensions (~1 min each). ss-eval reloads the texture from <run>/checkpoint.pt via --run.
